name: Meta Platforms

points.text: Revenue is growing 26.1% year over year (strong).
Earnings jumped +265% versus a year ago, but that mostly reflects a depressed prior year.
Operating margin is 37.8%.
Return on equity is 32.3%.
Debt/equity is 42% (conservative leverage).
Free-cash-flow margin is 7.0% of revenue.
It trades at 17.0x forward earnings.
PEG ratio is 0.73 (price paid per unit of growth).
EV/EBITDA is 13.3x.
Free-cash-flow yield is 1.1%.
Price is 3.4% below its 200-day average: the long-term trend is down.
The 50-day average is above the 200-day average (bullish alignment).
RSI(14) is 45: neutral.
MACD is negative and falling: momentum is deteriorating.
It is 22.1% below its 52-week high.
58 Wall Street analysts rate it 1.4/5 on average (strong buy).
The average analyst price target implies 39.2% upside.
Over 6 months it returned -4.5% versus -1.7% for the MSCI World benchmark.
Last month: -2.4%.
Annualised volatility is 43%.
Worst peak-to-trough fall in the past year: 28.7%.
Beta of 1.28: moves roughly with the market.
The portfolio holds 8% in Communication Services.

debate.said: Here is the case for owning Meta Platforms. Revenue is growing 26.1% year over year (strong). Operating margin is 37.8%. Return on equity is 32.3%.
I'm not convinced. Price is 3.4% below its 200-day average: the long-term trend is down. Free-cash-flow yield is 1.1%. MACD is negative and falling: momentum is deteriorating.
Price action is noise over a few weeks; the business is what we own — revenue is growing 26.1% year over year (strong). Weakness can be an entry point.
And the market knows that. It's priced in: free-cash-flow yield is 1.1%.

risk: Maximum position size: 11% of the portfolio (scaled for 43% volatility).
Every order costs a €1 fee, like on Trade Republic. Stop-loss rule: review at -15% from cost.
chair: Weighted committee score is +0.23 on a scale of -1 to +1; 3 of 5 analysts lean the same way. Conviction: Medium.
We own 0.2812 shares at an average cost of €554.82; position is -0.6%.
The thesis is intact. We keep holding.
